text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT SALE - Algeria on Tuesday bought 75,000 tonnes of French soft wheat at $150 per tonne FOB, traders said. The first shipment of 50,000 tonnes was for between February 25 and March 10 and another 25,000 tonnes was slated for shipment in the first half of March, exporters said.
WHEAT TENDERS - Morocco confirmed on Tuesday it will buy 40,000 tonnes of optional origin soft wheat on January 16 for delivery in the first half of February.

WHEAT TENDERS - Armenia is seeking about 65,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat under the PL 480 program for January 23-February 6 delivery, its U.S. export agent said. Offers are to be submitted on January 15 and will be valid until January 16.

- Yemen is scheduled to tender for soft wheat grain and soft wheat flour on January 14, grain traders said. Yemen is seeking 200,000 tonnes of European or U.S soft wheat flour for shipment by June. Within the EU, Yemen is seeking French, Dutch, German or Belgian flour. It also seeks 200,000 tonnes of optional soft wheat for shipment between June and August.

WHEAT TENDERS - Lebanon's economy ministry plans to buy 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard wheat later this month, the Cereals and Sugar Beet Office said. "It will be Hard Red Winter No.2," the official said.

- Bangladesh seeks 100,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 wheat or Australian standard or better Canadian winter red/spring wheat for shipment by February 21. Offers are to be opened Jan 18 and results announced two to three days later.

BARLEY TENDER - The Cyprus Grain Commission said on Monday it has invited tenders for the supply of one cargo of 25,000 tonnes of feed barley, with the tender closing January 17 and shipment between January 22 and February 5.
CORN TENDER - South Africa's Maize Board said on Monday it would offer by a tender 15,000 tonnes of yellow maize for either export or domestic use. The offer would close Jan 16.
CORN AND SOYBEAN TENDER - Taiwan traders said on Monday they expect to see perhaps two tenders this week for up to 70,000 tonnes of U.S. corn and 38,000 tonnes of soybeans.

SOYBEAN MEAL TENDER - The Commodity Credit Corp said it seeks offers from exporters for 2,650 tonnes of 48 percent protein soybean meal for donation to Guatemala. Shipment is slated for between January 30 and February 25, 1997. Offers were due on January 14 at 1400 CST
RICE TENDER - Syria's General Foreign Trade Organization for Chemicals and Foodstuffs is seeking to buy 12,000 tonnes of white rice for March shipment. Results would be Feb 13.
MARKET TALK - Joint oils and fats imports in China, Pakistan and India are set to rise to a record in the 1996/97 (Oct/Sept) season, the Oil World newsletter said.
It put the total for the three countries at 6.33 million tonnes versus 5.52 million in 1995/96.

China resold as much as 25,000 to 50,000 tonnes soyoil from Argentina to two commercial firms, U.S. exporters said. A recent rally in CBOT soyoil futures meant China could reap profits on recent purchases of soyoil, traders said.
